Mahua Moitra recalls past support from Suvendu Adhikari, sparking political discussion

Trinamool Congress leader Mahua Moitra shared an anecdote about receiving support from Suvendu Adhikari, now a BJP leader, during a difficult period in 2014 when she did not initially secure a Lok Sabha ticket. Moitra stated that Adhikari supported her through the night she cried and recalled their past personal ties, noting they no longer speak due to their differing political affiliations. The remarks have generated political buzz and speculation.
